exposure: history of one or two previous cesarean deliveries
Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 538,264 singleton nonanomalous births between 37 and 42 weeks GA complicated by maternal obesity (body mass index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m(2)) and history of one or two previous cesarean deliveries
finding: Compared with repeat cesarean section, trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) among obesity pregnancies at term increases the risk of maternal and neonatal complications.
